use: Write a blameless incident postmortem: sourced timeline, impact, root cause and contributing factors, detection and response review, and tracked action items with owners and dates. Use when an incident is contained and the team can supply logs, alerts, chat and notes.

steps.note: Inspect. The corpus is the generic corpus (docs/SKILL-TEMPLATE-STANDARD.md, section 6): prepare `<input>` with the files in scope, as text.
Map. For each chunk, run a fresh sub-task (a subagent if you can start one) that sees only that chunk file and the "Chunk task" below.
Verify. Check each timeline entry against its source line.
Report. Write the report in the format below.

protocol.title: Inspect
protocol.text: The corpus is the generic corpus (docs/SKILL-TEMPLATE-STANDARD.md, section 6): prepare `<input>` with the files in scope, as text. Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py scan <input>`. Note the file count, line count and top-level folders. If the corpus is very large, agree the scope with the user, then narrow it with `--include '<folder>'` (repeatable) on every command. Files over 20 MB are skipped; `--max-bytes N` changes the limit. Report what `scan` lists as skipped.

protocol.title: Partition
protocol.text: Run `WORK=$(mktemp -d)`, then `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py chunk <input> "$WORK/chunks"`. Chunks are limited to 800 lines and 100,000 characters each, and are cut between definitions where possible. Each `chunk_NNN.md` holds the data notice and labelled file sections. `manifest.json` lists the chunks.

protocol.title: Map
protocol.text: For each chunk, run a fresh sub-task (a subagent if you can start one) that sees only that chunk file and the "Chunk task" below. It writes `"$WORK/out/<chunk>.out.md"`. If you cannot start sub-tasks, run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py pending "$WORK/chunks" "$WORK/out"`. It lists the chunks that still have no output. Process the first one: read it, write its output, then run `pending` again. Repeat until nothing is pending. Never hold all chunks in context at once.

protocol.title: Reduce
protocol.text: Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py merge "$WORK/out" --out "$WORK/merged.json"`. If it lists `failed_outputs`, re-run those chunks. A missing or invalid output is not "no findings". Checks that span files (a duplicate across manifests, a route missing from a contract, a pattern repeated across chunks) are done on the merged list in this step. If the merged list is still too large to read, repeat steps 2 to 4 on the findings.

protocol.title: Verify
protocol.text: Check each timeline entry against its source line. Do not invent timestamps, numbers or owners; mark them unknown. Build the root cause in the reduce step by asking why from the impact until a cause the team can change is reached, labelling each step as sourced or hypothesis.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: Write the report in the format below.

protocol.title: Clean up
protocol.text: Delete `$WORK` after the report is delivered.
